findings.finding: The ordinary residual correction uses Python built-in sum() for the dot product. On Python 3.12, this is compensated summation, whereas the frozen BVLS-02 arithmetic requires ascending, separately rounded binary64 accumulation with no compensation or reassociation. The resulting ordinary correction is therefore not an admissible frozen-protocol result.
